identity.title: Archive local Codex transcripts to FastWork and recover disk space

values.task_boundary: Implement issue 5911 only; archive and verify but do not delete source transcripts or existing worktrees.
deliverables: typed bind enforcement for the canonical FastWork worktree parent
FastWork transcript archive manifest and verification result
exact deletion proposal requiring separate approval
acceptance_criteria: material local transcript consumers are identified with byte counts
FastWork archive is complete with a machine-readable checksum manifest
source and archive checksums verify before any deletion proposal
every newly bound ADL issue worktree resolves beneath /Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees
typed binding refuses a worktree outside the mandatory FastWork parent
repo policy and binding guidance name the same canonical parent
no transcript or existing worktree is deleted
non_goals: automatic relocation or deletion of existing worktrees
